lines: Commits on track/b-value-updates: 7a5f683 (backend+contracts+generated), fcc4314 (frontend), af7e12f (plan handoff), 0ca9b0c (review follow-up). Independent review approved; not landed, not pushed.

Endpoints: GET /v1/client/value-updates (client scope, paged, cursor bound to userId, microsecond keyset); GET /v1/admin/client-growth/funds/{fundId}/positions (client_values.read, unpaged, 404 unknown fund; items carry accountState since 0ca9b0c).

Contract file: packages/contracts/src/operations/value-updates.ts (VALUE_UPDATE_OPERATIONS, reuses AdminUserAccountState) registered in index.ts and generate-openapi.ts; regenerate openapi + frontend operations.ts at landing.
Notices: client_value_updated payload now {fundId, entryId, deepLink:'/portfolio'}; title/body unchanged.

Value after = position value right after that update (running sum over unreversed entries by created_at,id); NOT the current value: later contributions/updates move the portfolio away from the newest row. Client screen label: 'Value after this update'. Earlier text (af7e12f body, first handoff) wrongly said the newest row matches the portfolio; corrected in plan and here.
Reversed growth entries are hidden (decision accepted by reviewer).
Sheet keeps closed/suspended/invited clients (as collective preview does) and shows a state badge on those rows.
?entry= not found on loaded pages: nothing highlighted, no error.

Shared files touched (additive): composition.ts (+10, 779), adminRoutes.ts, clientRoutes.ts, resolveDestination.ts (notificationLink + ENTRY_DESTINATIONS, shared shape with b-receipts), NotificationsScreen.tsx, queryKeys.ts, PortfolioScreen.tsx, ClientPositionsScreen.tsx.
Checks on 0ca9b0c (Node 22 container): contracts 98 tests/138 ops; backend 98 files/1180; integration 41 files/427 (coverage off); frontend 28 files/246; build:client+build:admin pass.
Negative controls (on 7a5f683/fcc4314): user scope, permission, entryId mutations failed 3 integration tests; ignoring current gain failed 2 frontend sheet tests.
Not verified: browser/device runs, notification tap on device, APK export.
